taxonomic_note: Legacy Master Plant Pool name Lesquerella gracilis normalized to current accepted Physaria gracilis.
look_here_first: Delicate upright-to-sprawling annual with yellow-orange flowers and round to ellipsoid inflated capsules on straight or slightly curved pedicels.

project_inclusion.range_basis: Hays-local legacy source; Kew accepts Physaria gracilis; Texas sources document native Central Texas populations.
project_inclusion.range_guardrail: Installed for active visual learning; broader exact-county reconciliation deferred.

morphology_keys.family_pattern: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.
best_field_traits: stem leaves narrow and often sessile
fruiting pedicels straight to slightly curved
morphology_keys.comparison_training: More open and wiry than low dense P. densiflora. Fruit is inflated but the plant usually looks taller, looser, and more sprawling.
